decisions.statement: `Answering` names the index.
The `Reading` the indexes declare names the index.
`Shadow` names the index.
A name is the index only where the name is bound from the module declaring that name.
A parameter typed as text is a root where its name has `root`.
A parameter typed as text is a root where its name has `repo`.
A parameter typed as text is a root where its name has `repository`.
A page body is read by a name a module's page declares as a reader of one.
A page body is read by any function wrapping such a name.
A name reads a page body only where the name is bound from the module declaring that name.
A reader is what a module declares rather than what a body is seen to do.
A function taking a root beside the index and reading a page body from that root is refused.
A read one call down through a function of the same file taking a root is refused too.
A function taking a root and no index is admitted.
A function taking the index and no root is admitted.
A function taking a root beside the index and reading no page body is admitted.
A body-reading function called by an index-carrying function with no root of its own is admitted.
A file git is told to keep out of the commit is no page body.
No change has such a file.
No base version of such a file is there to go stale against.
The line named is the line the read is on.
The refusal names the remedy.
No file is exempt.
No folder is exempt.
No function is exempt.
The path of the file judged is not read.
A page body read by `readFileSync` off a root is not judged here.
A root reaching a function under a name with no root word is not seen.
A root carried inside the index rather than beside it is not seen.
A type holding the index rather than being the index names no index here.
A function reading twice is refused at its first read alone.

definition: the rule refusing a page body read off a repository root by code already handed the index
